image_description: A low-angle, close-up view of a massive radio telescope dish against a blue sky. The image highlights the complex steel lattice support structure (truss work) behind the parabolic surface, which appears to be made of solid white panels or fine mesh. A receiver cabin/feed horn assembly is visible at the focal point, suspended by struts. The scale is emphasized by the tiny appearance of maintenance walkways and railings on the structure.

The rim of the dish forms a consistent, smooth elliptical arc in this perspective, indicative of a precise parabolic geometry.
